judgment_calls.topic: Glucose bullets in the red box
judgment_calls.decision: Glucose < 4, and glucose ≥ 11.1 with ketonuria, are Urgent branches of the diabetes priority rule (they send to page 19 from inside the urgent box).
judgment_calls.alternatives: Treat them as cross-references only, with no priority.

judgment_calls.decision: Each listed sign (dry mouth, poor skin turgor, BP < 90/60, pulse ≥ 100) counts alone.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Require Dehydration (disorder), or two or more signs.

judgment_calls.decision: Only weight, BMI and waist circumference become a measure task; labs (HbA1c, eGFR, potassium, lipids), WHR and routing rows are not encoded.
